name: perfect-fivem
description: Resource-aware IntelliSense for FiveM: context-scoped native completion/hover, fxmanifest-driven client/server/shared detection, explorer decorations, and exports IntelliSense.

colors.description: Explorer badge color for FiveM client scripts.
Explorer badge color for FiveM server scripts.
Explorer badge color for FiveM shared scripts.
Explorer badge color for Lua files pulled in only via require(...), not listed directly in fxmanifest.lua.

perfectFivem.resourceDetection.excludeGl.description: Glob patterns excluded when scanning the workspace for fxmanifest.lua / __resource.lua resource roots.

perfectFivem.decorations.enable.description: Show client/server/shared/required badges on Lua files in the Explorer, based on the pre-computed fxmanifest + require() context index.

perfectFivem.natives.enable.description: Enable context-aware completion, hover and signature help for FiveM natives.

perfectFivem.natives.databasePath.description: Absolute path to a custom normalized natives.json to use instead of the bundled database. Leave empty to use the bundled database (see 'Perfect FiveM: Refresh Natives Database' to update it).

perfectFivem.natives.enableDiagnostics.description: Warn when a native is used in a script context (client/server) it is not available in.

perfectFivem.natives.deprecatedOverrides.description: Lua native names (e.g. 'SetPedAmmo') to flag as deprecated in diagnostics, in addition to the built-in list.

perfectFivem.imports.enable.description: Enable IntelliSense for exports('name', ...) / exports.name = ... consumed via exports['resource']:method() or exports.resource:method(), and for @resource/path imports declared in fxmanifest script arrays. Also enables go-to-definition/hover/workspace symbols/rename for exports and events.

perfectFivem.imports.enableEventCodeLens.description: Show a clickable 'N triggers'/'N handlers' CodeLens above RegisterNetEvent/AddEventHandler and TriggerEvent-family calls. Requires perfectFivem.imports.enable.

perfectFivem.oop.enable.description: Lightweight completion after Table: / Table. for local `function Table:Method(...)` / `function Table.Method(...)` declarations found elsewhere in the same resource. Pattern-based only, no type inference - a real Lua language server (e.g. cfxlua-vscode) is the complete solution; see the README.

perfectFivem.rcon.enable.description: Enable the RCON status bar item, connect/disconnect commands, and restart-on-save.

perfectFivem.rcon.autoRestartOnSave.description: When connected via RCON, automatically run 'refresh; ensure <resource>' for the resource that owns the file you just saved.

perfectFivem.rcon.restartDelayMs.description: Debounce delay (ms) before an auto-restart is sent, so saving several files in the same resource in quick succession only triggers one restart.
